title: Vertical Farming: Hong Kong deep edition

questions.q: In "Read your local market Understand", which of these is a key idea?
o: Freelancers are common; write scope, price and date in one page before work starts.
Three languages in daily use: your page in two (Traditional Chinese and English) is the minimum.
Choose sole trader, partnership or company: a company separates personal and business risk, but has yearly filing duties. Check with a local expert.
Local caution: A city with high costs: test one small offer before you sign a lease.

questions.q: In "Choose your sector Analyse", which of these is a key idea?
o: Cluster H, People and business support: Coaching, coworking and outsourcing fit well; many one-person firms need flexible support.
Name partners: an equipment maker, a power supplier, a buyer, a packer or delivery partner.
Break-even units = fixed monthly cost divided by contribution per unit; round up.
Check against a worse case: if sales are 25% lower, do you still cover costs?

questions.q: In "Register and license Apply", which of these is a key idea?
o: Check land use, building and fire rules, water and waste rules, and food safety rules for selling produce. Check with a local expert.
Log growing data: light hours, water, nutrients, temperature; keep batch records for each harvest.
Cluster F, Food and farming: Land is scarce: vertical farms, ghost kitchens and alternative proteins suit small floor areas.
Close to the wider region: many small firms serve customers across the border, so shipping and data rules matter early. Check with a local expert.

questions.q: In "Protect data and customers Apply", which of these is a key idea?
o: Say in plain words what you collect and why; give a way to see and correct it.
Keep a risk list with a response for each; include a rules change. Check with a local expert.
A monthly review: what we planned, what happened, what we change.
Show proof: harvest weight, shelf life and a buyer trial with a restaurant or shop.

questions.q: In "Price, tax and money Evaluate", which of these is a key idea?
